name: AutoDS — Dropshipping Product Research & Store Automation
description:
AutoDS connects Claude to your AutoDS dropshipping account so you can research products, manage your catalog, and publish to your stores in natural language.

Product research
- Search the AutoDS product database and surface winning products with proven demand
- Browse the full category tree, or pull recommended and similar products to expand a niche
- Open any product for the details behind the listing — price, variations, shipping time, supplier

Store & catalog management
- List your connected stores across selling channels (eBay, Amazon, Shopify, Etsy, Facebook, Wix, WooCommerce, TikTok)
- Browse your products with rich filters (status, channel, supplier, region, inventory)
- Import products from a supplier link, a CSV, or a category — as drafts, scheduled, or live — and publish drafts to your selling channel
- Track an import job item by item until every product has landed
- Check your plan, add-ons, and credit balances before spending them

Products come back with their images, so you can compare items by how they look, not just by title.

AutoDS is a leading all-in-one dropshipping platform used by thousands of sellers to source, research, and automate ecommerce stores. Learn more at autods.com.

_published_faq.name: How do I add AutoDS — Dropshipping Product Research & Store Automation to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add AutoDS — Dropshipping Product Research & Store Automation to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.autods.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the AutoDS — Dropshipping Product Research & Store Automation MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: AutoDS — Dropshipping Product Research & Store Automation lists 13 MCP tools, including get_bulk_action_items, get_current_user, get_product_by_id, get_recommended_products, get_similar_products, get_winning_products, list_products, list_stores_api, publish_drafts_to_marketplace, search_products, upload_products, and get_categories.

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to AutoDS — Dropshipping Product Research & Store Automation in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.

_published_faq.name: Does AutoDS — Dropshipping Product Research & Store Automation MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: AutoDS — Dropshipping Product Research & Store Automation requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops AutoDS — Dropshipping Product Research & Store Automation?

acceptedAnswer.text: AutoDS — Dropshipping Product Research & Store Automation is developed by AutoDS LTD. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
